description: Broken link checker and dead link checker for AI agents: verify up to 10 URLs before citing or sending them. Per URL returns a verdict (live, dead/404, soft_404, parked domain, blocked_or_rate_limited, unreachable/DNS error), HTTP status, final URL after redirects, page title, meta description, and optionally whether an expected phrase appears on the page. Catches hallucinated, rotted and redirected-to-homepage links. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).
name: verify_links
